summary: Rogers Communications Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching an underwriting agreement dated September 9, 2026 and two supplemental indentures, dated September 23, 2026, with The Bank of New York Mellon. The company will issue US$500 million of 7.150% fixed-to-fixed rate subordinated notes due 2057 (NC5) and US$500 million of 7.400% fixed-to-fixed rate subordinated notes due 2057 (NC10), totaling US$1 billion, through underwriters led by BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, MUFG, SMBC Nikko and Wells Fargo. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
